formato: Entrevista oral por videollamada, con cámara. La nota de la entrevista se promedia con la del examen escrito.
preparacion: Cámara encendida y un espejo detrás de ti, como lo piden el día del examen.
Sin notas en pantalla ni en papel.
Respuestas de 45 a 90 segundos: una idea, una razón y un ejemplo.
Grábate, escúchate y anota tres errores. Repite la misma pregunta al día siguiente.

en: Let me think about that for a moment.
To be honest, I'm not sure, but...
On the one hand, ... On the other hand, ...
Sorry, could you say that again, please?
I'm afraid I didn't catch the last part.
Let me put that another way.
I'm going on holiday in a fortnight.

preguntas: Introduce yourself in about two minutes: who you are, where you are from, what you studied and what you do now.
Tell me about yourself and your family.
How would your friends describe you?
What did you study at university, and why did you choose it?
Which course did you find most difficult, and how did you deal with it?
What is the most useful thing you have learnt at university?
How do you usually prepare for an important exam?
If you could change one thing about your degree, what would it be?
What do you do for a living? Describe a typical working day.
What do you like most and least about your job?
Tell me about a problem you had at work and how you solved it.
What skills does someone need to be good at your job?
Do you prefer working alone or in a team? Why?
Tell me about your graduation project. What problem does it solve, and who uses it?
Which technologies did you use, and why did you choose them?
What was the hardest part of the project?
What would you do differently if you started it again?
What are your plans for the next five years?
Would you like to study or work abroad? Why, or why not?
Why do you need English, and how have you learnt it so far?
What would you like to study after your degree?
Do you think artificial intelligence will change your profession? How?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of working from home?
Some people say experience matters more than a university degree. Do you agree?
How has technology changed the way people learn?
Is it better to work for a large company or to run your own business?
Should children learn to program at school?
Describe the place where you live.
What do you usually do at the weekend?
Tell me about the last film or series you watched.
Describe a trip you remember well.
What did you do last weekend, and what are you going to do next weekend?
